main_text.l: scitia: quæ non redarguit, quæ fallaci frontis argumento dat vi-ĉtas manus: Sermo, nutus, ge-stus,dolis ubique ac mendaciis infames: Inusta est, ô pudor! detergi non potest illa nota: Palam est, celari non potest: Perfricuerunt jam sæpiùs homines, & ingenuam frontem triverunt: Superest servilis, quæ adversum Conscientiæ carnificinam induruit callo: Et sub verbere negat & pejerat obstinata: Si tempestate hac, vultu ducimur & linguâ, faveamus ergo vasramento, & repulso candore, suffragio nostro gaudeat indignus competitor, amicorum larvas numeremus imposterum, non amicos: Fidem & officiosam sollicitudinem ad vivum imitantur inanes rugæ & inquies & crebra sciscitatio: Benevolentiam simulant obsequia, & ne si-

page.notes: Show-through text at the right edge of the scan is not transcribed. Catchword "ne si-" appears at the foot right of the last line and is given in the text as a broken word. Two doubtful readings: "vasramento" (probably "vaframento") and "ĉtas" (initial letter of "actas"/"factas" unclear).
